WAAREEENER.d: Waaree Energies manufactures solar photovoltaic modules and provides engineering, procurement, and construction services for solar power plants. It is India's largest solar panel manufacturer.

WAAREERTL.d: Waaree Renewable Technologies Limited provides solar engineering, procurement, and construction services, along with power generation. It caters to commercial, industrial, and utility-scale customers across India.

WABAG.d: VA Tech Wabag Limited provides water treatment and management services for municipal and industrial clients globally. It specializes in designing, building, and operating water and wastewater infrastructure.

WELCORP.d: Welspun Corp manufactures large-diameter submerged arc welded pipes, ductile iron pipes, and steel products. It serves major oil, gas, and water infrastructure projects globally.

WELENT.d: Welspun Enterprises executes infrastructure development projects, focusing on roads, highways, and water supply systems. It operates primarily as an engineering, procurement, and construction contractor for government and private entities.

WESTLIFE.d: Westlife Foodworld operates McDonald's restaurants across West and South India through its subsidiary. Its main customers are retail consumers seeking quick-service food.

WEWORK.d: WeWork India Management provides flexible workspace solutions, managed offices, and community spaces for businesses of all sizes. It is a major flexible workspace provider in major Indian cities.

WHEELS.d: Wheels India Limited manufactures steel and aluminum wheels for commercial vehicles, passenger cars, and agricultural tractors. Its main customers are major automotive original equipment manufacturers.

WIPRO.d: Wipro Limited provides global information technology, consulting, and business process services to enterprises across diverse industries. It operates as a major software services provider headquartered in Bengaluru.

WOCKPHARMA.d: Wockhardt Limited develops, manufactures, and markets generic and branded pharmaceutical formulations and biologicals. It serves global markets including the UK, US, Ireland, and India.
